entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Reconquista South & Conquest of the Algarve, a transformative movement in Portugal (1143–1279). Emerged from Military Order and Treaty of Zamora – Castile recognises Portuguese independence. Catalyzed Siege and capture of Lisbon with Crusader assistance and Conquest of Ceuta – beginning of the Age of Discovery.
